description: This Java source file defines the AlarmService class, an Android Activity that demonstrates scheduling and canceling alarms using AlarmManager, with UI buttons to start and stop a repeating alarm.

classes.name: AlarmService
classes.description: An Android Activity that schedules and cancels alarms, demonstrating alarm management with UI controls.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the UI, and assigns click listeners to start and stop alarm buttons.

methods.name: mStartAlarmListener
methods.description: OnClickListener that schedules a repeating alarm to trigger after 30 seconds.

methods.name: mStopAlarmListener
methods.description: OnClickListener that cancels the scheduled alarm.
